# retention-policy

A smal module that records a retention polcy for one service.

## Tests

- `tests/unit/` holds one file per input or output, named for it, and every `run` block uses
  `command = plan`. `make test` formats and runs these.
- `tests/integration/` holds tests that `apply`. CI runs them with `make integration` in a sandbox
  account, and nobody adds to them without the platform team.

Checks run with `make test`, which also checks formating.

input.command: sed -i 's|description = "the name"|description = "Name of the service the retention policy applies to. Also used as the prefix of the policy_name output."|; s|description = "days"|description = "Number of days the service'"'"'s data is retained under the policy."|' variables.tf && sed -i 's/smal /small /; s/polcy/policy/; s/formating/formatting/' README.md && git diff && (terraform fmt -check 2>&1 | head)

I rewrote both variable descriptions in `variables.tf` and fixed three typos in `README.md`. I didn't run `make test` or any other tests. Only description strings and prose changed, so I didn't add or change any tests. `terraform fmt -check` printed nothing, so formatting is fine.

- **`name`:** now reads "Name of the service the retention policy applies to. Also used as the prefix of the policy_name output."
- **`retention_days`:** now reads "Number of days the service's data is retained under the policy."
- **README typos:** "smal" is now "small", "polcy" is now "policy", and "formating" is now "formatting".

The `retention_days` wording is my reading of the name. Nothing in `main.tf` says what the number is actually applied to, so check that "data is retained" is what you mean.
